evals.prompt: You've tried the same fix for this failing test 3 times and it fails the same way. Break the loop.
evals.expected_output: Stuck protocol: emit 'Stuck: [task], attempt N, last blocker: [X]', switch approach or tool; after 2 failed switches escalate to the user.
assertions: Emits a 'Stuck: <task>, attempt N, last blocker: <X>' line
Switches to a genuinely different approach or tool, not the same fix again
States that after 2 approach switches without progress it escalates to the user rather than cycling silently

evals.prompt: Work through these 12 small refactors one by one, keep cycling until done. Context is already at 80%.
evals.expected_output: Runs the cycle (inspect, act, verify narrowly, checkpoint) but context over 75% forces a handoff and stop.
assertions: Context budget over 75% triggers emitting a handoff and stopping the loop
Per-step output is one line (verdict plus artifact), only what changed or failed
Does not busy-wait on running monitors

evals.prompt: Design the architecture for a new notification service from scratch.
evals.expected_output: Design work routes to plan or brainstorming, not an execution loop.
assertions: Does not enter an inspect/act/verify cycle
Treats it as planning or design
